utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still sorting out the timing, but I should know the repair drive day soon. I’ll let Faye know right away once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli — just let me know when it’s set, and I’ll bring the screwdriver, duct tape, hammer, and extension cord. If I spot a folding chair, I’ll grab that too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — I appreciate it. I’ll tell Faye as soon as I know the day.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the toolbox and set a clear drop-off window for the repair drive. That should make the timing and where to leave things nice and clear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds really helpful, Gus. I’ll pass along anything I hear and let Kira know right away if anything new comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — appreciate it. Just let me know if the timing shifts or the drop-off spot changes, and I’ll keep the toolbox ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ve got tape, glue, and a few screws for Saturday afternoon at the community shed, and I can help sort the other supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, that helps a lot — I’ll tell Rey to sort the tools, and I’ll pass along the usual fixes list to Oren once it’s ready. Ira’s listening for any updates while she’s out running errands too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good — I’ll keep my tape, glue, and screws ready for Saturday afternoon at the community shed, and help sort whatever else comes in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Jules is spreading the word, and Nell’s still looking for a few hands and tools. I’ll keep an ear out for anyone handy with small-appliance repair.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds good—I can keep an ear out too. Oren, Rey, and Gus all pitch in in different ways, so we’ve got a decent start.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that helps. If anyone handy with small-appliance repair comes to mind, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Rey’s got the tools, right? And if we spell out the remaining tasks, Noah can jump in right away?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard a fresh update on that yet, but Ira said they’d pass anything along right away. If Opal’s asking around, maybe we’ll get a few more volunteers soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so we’re still waiting on a fresh update, and Ira will let me know if anything comes in? I’m just making sure we’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — I still need the repair drive timing first, so please let me know as soon as Uli has the day. I’ll keep things flexible until then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — once Uli has the day, we can set a simple time and keep the plan steady. I’ll bring my notepad for the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thank you — once Uli knows the day, please tell me right away and we’ll lock in the timing. I’ll keep my schedule open until then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive and sort the tools later. I’ll stop by to get filled in by Quinn when I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be a big help, Rey. We’re at the community shed Saturday afternoon, and I’m still gathering tape, screws, glue, batteries, and a few basics.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring a folding chair and help sort whatever tools turn up. I’ll check in with Quinn when I stop by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll ask around for volunteers and see who can bring tools for the repair drive. Bo can bring a basic toolkit and gloves, and Gus can bring the tools too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can bring the basic toolkit and gloves. Thanks for lining up the extra help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks Bo — that covers us. I’ll keep asking around and see if anyone else can help with tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll keep an eye out for the repair drive list, and I’ll make sure Rey gets the tools sorted before it starts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Dane — that helps a lot. If you hear anything new about the repair drive, pass it along and I’ll spread the word fast.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll pass along anything new as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday afternoon at the community shed sounds workable, as long as the drop-off window is clear. Once that’s settled, I’d say we can let Faye know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Works for me. I’ll bring the screwdriver set and spare batteries, and I’ll check who’s still waiting for help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good—just please make sure the drop-off window is clear before we tell Faye. Saturday afternoon at the community shed should work if the tools and helpers are lined up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll put together a quick list of the homes and flag any urgent fixes I spot. Let’s make sure we catch the ones that need help first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you give me the exact homes and the urgent fixes you spotted? I want the details before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — I’ll jot down the exact homes and the urgent fixes I noticed, then send you the list right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll swing by if anyone needs a hand, and I’ll make sure Gus brings that toolbox. We’re just waiting on the repair drive timing first, since Faye needs to work it around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — it’s set for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the home list over to Leo once Mara’s quick check is ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll keep an eye out for Mara’s quick check, and Gus will bring that toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll ask around for volunteers and see who can bring tools for the repair drive. Gus can bring the tools, and Bo can bring a basic toolkit and some gloves.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. I’m still sorting the timing, but I should know the repair drive day soon and I’ll let Faye know right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good—once you know the day, let me know and I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard we still need volunteers and a few tools for the repair drive. If Opal’s asking around, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m bringing the screwdriver, duct tape, hammer, and the extension cord, and I’ll try to find that folding chair too. I’ll pitch in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s really helpful, Oren — thanks. I’ll keep spreading the word and tell Opal we’ve got those tools covered.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got my toolbox ready, and I can bring the tools by. Let’s set a clear drop-off window so Pia has the timing and details before she helps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that works for me. I can bring a basic toolkit and gloves, and Rey can help sort the tools too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — I’ll bring my toolbox and we can make the drop-off window clear for everyone. I’ll keep Tess posted on any fresh updates so Pia has the details too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — that’d help a lot. If anyone handy with small appliances comes to mind, I’d appreciate the introduction.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll keep an eye out and introduce anyone handy with small appliances. And I’ll make sure folks know the repair drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I really appreciate it. Sunday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me — let’s pick a time, make the fix-it list, and see who can bring tools. I’ll bring a notepad so we can keep it all clear.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll swing by if you need an extra hand, and I’ll make sure Gus brings that toolbox. Faye’s waiting on the timing first, so once we’ve got that, she can fit it around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, let’s set the time first and then we can keep the list tidy. I’ll have the notepad ready when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll let you know right away if I hear anything about the repair drive. Oren’s bringing a screwdriver, and maybe a hammer, duct tape, an extension cord, and even a folding chair.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so you’ll tell me right away if anything changes, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes — I’ll tell you right away if anything changes about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll keep an eye out for the repair drive list, and I’ll make sure Rey gets the tools sorted before it starts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll bring the screwdriver set and spare batteries on Saturday afternoon. I’ll also check who’s still waiting for help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate it. I’ll let Rey know to get the tools sorted and keep watching for the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: The repair drive’s set for Saturday afternoon at the community shed. I’m gathering tape, screws, glue, batteries, and a few basic tools—Hana can help with some items, and Bo may bring a toolkit and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I can help sort whatever turns up and keep things moving on Saturday. If you need me to bring anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — sorting would be a huge help. I’ll keep gathering supplies, and if you can bring a small box or bags to organize things, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday afternoon at the community shed should work, but we should keep the drop-off window clear so nothing gets missed. Once that’s settled, we can let Faye know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’s a start, but I still need the exact date, time, location, and what people should bring before I can help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It’s Saturday afternoon at the community shed, and Oren and Cleo are covering the basics, with Eli and Rey able to help. I’m still worried about the drop-off window, so let’s keep that clear before we tell Faye.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive, and I’ll sort the tools later too. I’ll stop by to get filled in, and I can check if you still need more volunteers or tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — I still need the repair drive timing first since Uli’s sorting that out. Once I have it, I can fit things around school pickup and let you know what else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, that works — I’ll wait for Uli’s timing and stop by for the update. If you need anything else after school pickup, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara—once your quick check is ready, send me the list and I’ll get it over to Leo. The repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center, so we’re all lined up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do, Rosa. I’ll send over the homes list and flag anything urgent as soon as I finish the quick check.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara—thank you. Once it’s in, I’ll pass the home list to Leo so he can see who’s still waiting.
